featured_reviews.review_text:
Don't spoil your special functions to and go with these guys. We had booked them for our marriage reception function and I will regret that for the rest of my life. First of all, extremely unprofessional about timing which was conveyed months in advance. Then the main guy didn't even show up saying "i will be moving between your function and another one".

And lastly which is the MOST important thing, ruined our pictures!! Not even 1 photo is usable. They are so bad with their job. I mean the most basic thing is to click straight pictures but unfortunately they could not even do that. Horrible editing on top of that. Just so so bad.

I can't get my night back but you can save yourself from regretting and spoiling your special days.

featured_reviews.name: Hutoxi Mehta
featured_reviews.review_text: Ever since my father discovered Liberty Photo Arts decades ago, we have not needed to look anywhere else for any photography needs. Be it our college or office IDs, or passports and visa photos and tons of holiday trips photos, this family-run business, most conveniently located at 5 minutes walking distance from VT Station, Rajeshbhai did it all for my family for years, helped by loyal-till-today Jayantbhai. Those hundreds of photos are as vivid today as ever, precious unforgettable memories. Now his young son Devang is efficiently and enthusiastically carrying forward the business and it's a pleasure to see his smiling, kindly mother also sitting at the shop to help out. They are patient, hardworking and take a lot of trouble to be perfect till the customer is completely satisfied. Their rates are reasonable too. Two recent examples: 1.After the Covid-lockdown had eased and I needed some photos printed even though the shop was not open regularly, they made sure that the prints were delivered to me through neighbouring establishments, from where I could pick them up at my convenience. 2.Recently I wanted a print of an old picture on an ancient, rusty biscuit tin. 'Liberty' exceeded all my expectations and produced a wonderful copy after painstaking efforts and even framed it for me. In both these instances, Devang played a huge part in organising, corresponding and doing the needful with much patience, understanding and hard work. I surely commend Liberty Photo Arts to anyone for any photography needs anytime. Thank you 'Liberty'.

featured_reviews.name: Ravindra Raje
featured_reviews.review_text:
Liberty Photo Arts were appointed to click pics at the birthday party of the daughter of my nephew Mr Rahul Raje  owner of a logistics business.
I attended this party and was impressed by the manner in which Liberty Photo picked up the relevant events and clicked them in their cameras. They encouraged the guests to display attractive poses with the result the photos came out very well. These were even framed instantly and given to the persons appearing in the photos. Must say a nice gesture. No doubt these photos will be a good memory for posterity and will later help in taking us down the memory lane.
Thanks Liberty for your nice professional effort.  It added spice to the wonderful function organized by my nephew Rahul Raje.

featured_reviews.name: Sapna G
featured_reviews.review_text: Thank you for creating such amazing memories for us on my brothers engagement. Devang is the perfectionist and helped us some great candid shots.

featured_reviews.name: Bhagyashree Chaudhari
featured_reviews.review_text:
1★ Highly disappointed with the service*

We booked them for my brother’s wedding. Engagement was on 24th Dec and the package was around 33k which included photos, cinematic video, and an Instagram reel. We finalized them because their Instagram page looked really good.

The photos were delivered on time, but the editing was very basic – just looked like a filter was added and sent. After continuous follow-up, 2 months after the engagement they provided a poorly edited video and reel. The cinematic video was poorly cut and the quality was very poor. The reel was even worse – completely amateur work, nothing like what they post on their own page.

Worst part is after taking the full 33k upfront, they have been ignoring our calls and WhatsApp messages for the last 4 months. Zero accountability.

We trusted them with our memories and paying 33k for this service was heartbreaking. Don’t go by their social media. Extremely unprofessional team

customer_updates.text: The true photographer with a great heritage. It's more of nostalgia for us. It's probably one of the largest photo studios in Mumbai. Has old art deco interiors. featured_reviews.review_text:
Sam is one of the finest, most contemporary photographers I've come across. She's got a keen eye for detail and she's a thorough professional in her work.

When you talk to her, you'd see the passion for photography oozing out and she gives beyond 100% to every project she works on.

You would be surprised at her creativity and would always end up thinking - HOW DID SHE DO THAT?

She once told me - Every Frame is Unique and it's the perspective which changes the meaning of each frame. Trust me - her perspectives are Humane, Unique, Bold, Modern yet it talks to people across age groups, ethnicities and classes.

If any1 collaborates with Sam, I can very well vouch for an experience beyond Delight!
